observations.name: short chat

input.draft: Hi Alex, I wanted to remind you that the remaining ₹2,400 payment is due by Friday. Please let me know once you have sent it. I cannot extend the deadline.

output.rewrite: Hi Alex, this is a reminder that the remaining ₹2,400 payment is due by Friday. Please confirm once sent. The deadline cannot be extended.
output.explanation: Simplified the phrasing to be more direct and concise, removing redundant words while preserving all essential information.

observations.semanticReview: Agent-reviewed: shorter chat text preserves Alex, ₹2,400, Friday, confirmation request, and refusal to extend the deadline.

observations.name: detailed email

input.draft: Hi Priya, I might finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm that yet. I will share an update tomorrow.

output.rewrite: Hi Priya, I might finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm that yet. I will share an update tomorrow.
output.explanation: The draft is already clear and appropriately written for a friendly email. No changes were needed to preserve the original meaning, tone, or intent.

observations.semanticReview: Agent-reviewed failure: facts preserved but required email subject/body formatting was ignored.

observations.name: grammar only with conflicting options

input.draft: Hi Alex, i accept your invitation and will attends on Friday. i cant promise Monday.

output.rewrite: Hi Alex, I accept your invitation and will attend on Friday. I can't promise Monday.
output.explanation: Capitalized 'I', corrected 'attends' to 'attend', and added apostrophe to 'can't'.

observations.semanticReview: Agent-reviewed: capitalization, verb agreement, and apostrophe corrected with minimal wording changes. Acceptance and inability to promise Monday preserved despite conflicting disabled options.

observations.name: detailed email after explicit format prompt correction

input.draft: Hi Priya, I might finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm that yet. I will share an update tomorrow.

output.rewrite:
Subject: Report Progress Update

Hi Priya,

I might finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm that yet. I will share an update tomorrow.

Best regards,
Priya
output.explanation: Added a Subject line per email format requirements and kept the original friendly tone and content intact.

observations.semanticReview: Agent-reviewed failure: subject/body added, but recipient Priya was incorrectly reused as a sender signature. Tightened instruction to omit sign-offs unless present in the draft.

observations.name: detailed email after no-signature correction

input.draft: Hi Priya, I might finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm that yet. I will share an update tomorrow.

output.rewrite:
Subject: Report Update Timeline

Hi Priya,

I may finish the report by Wednesday, but I cannot confirm this yet. I will provide an update tomorrow.
output.explanation: Changed 'might' to 'may', 'share' to 'provide', and 'that' to 'this' for smoother phrasing while preserving meaning.

observations.semanticReview: Agent-reviewed: subject and body produced; recipient, uncertain Wednesday completion, and tomorrow update preserved; no invented signature. Different resolved model means the success cannot be attributed only to prompt changes.

limitations: Five fictional live calls; three scenarios plus two corrective email retries. Semantic preservation and preference compliance are not guaranteed across free-router models.
